rules.printed_item: IV.1 Gross compensation income (owner's 2316)
rules.formula: From the owner's own employer certificate (2316), not the business payroll. Books has no compensation path in MVP.
rules.status_detail: Compensation path MISSING in Books (books.md s2; design P7).

rules.printed_item: IV.2 Non-taxable or exempt compensation
rules.formula: From the owner's 2316. Not amounts paid to business employees.

rules.printed_item: IV.3 Taxable compensation
rules.formula: IV.1 - IV.2. Per person.

rules.printed_item: IV.4 Tax due on compensation
rules.formula: Graduated schedule applied to IV.3 (progressive, not flat).
rules.status_detail: No pinned box is mapped to IV.4 (W2 check). The ATP box is mapped to IV.18A by pattern.

rules.printed_item: IV.5 Sales, revenues and fees
rules.formula: Sum of posted sales lines (sales_revenue and related leaf accounts), annual, excluding VAT and non-sales movements. Posted only; reversals net; no parent accounts.
rules.status_detail: Official key bound (verify.md s4). Selector PARTIAL: only graduated or special pathways.

rules.printed_item: IV.6 Sales returns, allowances and discounts
rules.formula: Sum of contra-sales (refunds_and_discounts) linked to eligible sales, annual.
rules.status_detail: Books has no credit-note or sales-return document (books.md s2: MISSING).

rules.printed_item: IV.7 Net sales (IV.5 - IV.6)
rules.formula: Display only. The key name says taxable compensation, but the box is net sales (verify.md s2 #15).

rules.printed_item: IV.8 Cost of sales or services (itemized only)
rules.formula: Allowable cost of goods or direct services. Itemized method only. OSD and 8% do not deduct it separately.

rules.printed_item: IV.9 Gross income from operation
rules.formula: IV.7 - IV.8 (IV.8 omitted for OSD).

rules.printed_item: IV.10A Ordinary allowable itemized deductions
rules.formula: Tax-eligible operating expenses with substantiation, itemized method only. Not every book expense is deductible; avoid double-counting cost of sales.
rules.status_detail: Deductibility rules and limits need tax review per line (workbook I.17 notes).

rules.printed_item: IV.10B Special allowable itemized deductions
rules.formula: Specific supported special deductions. Not in MVP.

rules.printed_item: IV.10C Net operating loss carryover
rules.formula: Eligible loss vintages and time limits. Not in MVP.

rules.printed_item: IV.10D Total allowable itemized deductions
rules.formula: IV.10A + IV.10B + IV.10C. Do not mix with OSD.

rules.printed_item: IV.11 Optional standard deduction (OSD)
rules.formula: 40% of IV.7 (net sales), only when OSD is validly elected.
rules.status_detail: CONFLICT: printed Part I item 17 says 40% of gross sales (bir.md s2); the code and the workbook say 40% of net sales (form_1701a.rs:470-471; workbook IV.11). Needs review.
citations: bir.md s2 (Part IV item 11, Part I item 17)

rules.printed_item: IV.12 Net income or loss

rules.printed_item: IV.13 Other non-operating income (graduated path)
rules.formula: Eligible other non-operating income. Exclude income subject to final tax when appropriate (EXC.FINAL_TAX_INTEREST).
rules.status_detail: Final-tax attribute on interest income is UNKNOWN (sheets.md s10).

rules.printed_item: IV.14 Taxable income from business (IV.12 + IV.13)
rules.formula: Net income plus other non-operating income. Apply the loss rules.

rules.printed_item: IV.15 Taxable compensation and business income (IV.3 + IV.14)
rules.formula: Graduated base. The 2023+ bracket table applies to this value (rates-v1).
rules.status_detail: Printed-form base is the graduated pathway. The graduated table is applied to IV.15 (sheets.md s6 #5, verify.md s2 #50).

rules.printed_item: IV.16 Special or preferential rate

rules.printed_item: IV.17 Special, preferential or exempt tax due

rules.printed_item: IV.18B Total tax due under graduated rates
rules.formula: Graduated schedule applied to IV.15 (rates-v1 2023+ table). Feeds II.22.
